body.translated_text: Homage to the Omniscient One!

body.text:

children.translated_text: of the Omniscient One's instruction,
I open [this] in the midst of the noble assembly. // 1 //

body.translated_text: Having first bowed to the foremost in the world, who has crossed beyond the abode of suffering, of infinite extent, the treasure-chest of the jewels of the teachings

children.translated_text: Whose banner of fame is renowned throughout the three worlds, whose lion's roar is the sound of the true <s>Dharma</s>,
The entire treasure-chest of jewels attained through hardship, whose feet are rubbed by the crest-jewel of the <s>Brahmāṇḍa</s> (cosmic egg). // 2 //
Of the entire unfathomable and boundless ocean of Buddhist <s>Vinaya</s> (monastic discipline),
This <s>Prātimokṣa</s> is called the heart-essence, the foundation. // 3 //
This is the collection of the written records of the true <s>Dharma</s> of the King of true <s>Dharma</s>;
This is the merchant-guild of <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks), the great market of the merchandise of training. // 4 //

body.translated_text: This is the raft for crossing the ocean-deep <s>saṃsāra</s>; this is the path of victory over the <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions), the foremost

children.translated_text: This stands like the foundation stairway for ascending to the city of <s>mokṣa</s> (liberation);

children.text: nirvṛte mayi yuṣmākam eṣa śāstety abhiṣṭutaḥ // 7 //
children.translated_text: When I have passed into <s>nirvāṇa</s>, this has been praised as your teacher. // 7 //
Oneself [should guard] ... diligently and carefully;
With eyes destroyed [by delusion] on all sides ...
... is not [understood] by the uninitiated;
The <s>Prātimokṣa</s> should always be guarded by <s>bhikṣus</s> who desire liberation.
Even when conquered, it proceeds for the harmful ... ;
Even to one who has been helped, it desires to do harm ...
The hearing of the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> is difficult to obtain even in tens of millions of <s>kalpas</s> (cosmic ages);
Its grasping, retaining, and even [a single] transgression are extremely rare. // 8 //

children.translated_text: Happy is the harmony of the <s>Saṃgha</s>; happy is the austerity of the <s>śramaṇas</s> (ascetics). // 9 //

body.translated_text: Happy is the arising of <s>Buddhas</s>; happy is the teaching of the <s>Dharma</s>;

children.text: sukhaṃ darśanam āryāṇāṃ saṃvāso 'pi satā sukhaḥ /
children.translated_text: Happy is the sight of the Noble Ones; happy too is dwelling with the virtuous;

children.text: adarśanena bālānāṃ nityam eva sukhaṃ bhavet* // 10 //
children.translated_text: Through not seeing fools, one would always be happy. // 10 //

body.text: sukhaṃ dṛṣṭāḥ śīlavantaḥ sukhaṃ dṛṣṭā bahuśrutāḥ /

who are freed from rebirth. // 11 //

body.translated_text: Happy is the sight of the virtuous; happy is the sight of the learned;

children.text: sukhā nadī sukhaṃ tīrthaṃ sukhaṃ dharmajito jataḥ /
children.translated_text: Happy is the river, happy the sacred ford; happy the victory won through <s>Dharma</s>;
Happy is the attainment of <s>prajñā</s> (wisdom), and happy is the destruction of the conceit of 'I am.' // 12 //

children.text: sukho hi vāsaḥ kṛtaniścayānāṃ jitendriyāṇāṃ ca bahuśrutānām* /
children.translated_text: Happy indeed is the dwelling of those of firm resolve, who have conquered the senses, who are learned,

children.text: śānteṣv araṇyeṣu jarāṃ gatānāṃ vaneṣu nirvāpitayauvanānām* // 13 //
children.translated_text: Who have grown old in peaceful forests, their youth extinguished in the woods. // 13 //

children.translated_text: Having bowed

having joined my palms before him,

mahātmanaḥ ye vacanamātreṇa yathābhāgān na nivartante /

children.translated_text: Those great beings who by mere words do not turn away from their rightful portions — those person-horses will indeed
become conquerors of the battle-field of the <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions). // 17 //

[PrMoSū_Mū-Banerjee 7]

children.translated_text: If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, may the <s>Saṃgha</s> consent and approve that the <s>Saṃgha</s> hold the <s>Poṣadha</s> and recite the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s>. This is the motion (<s>jñapti</s>).
The recitation
of the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s>.

body.translated_text: Let the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> listen! Today is the <s>Saṃgha's</s> <s>Poṣadha</s> (observance day),

body.text: poṣadhaṃ vayam āyuṣman kariṣyāmaḥ prātimokṣasūtroddeśam uddeśāmaḥ / yasya syā

children.translated_text: has a transgression (<s>āpatti</s>), that person should
disclose it. When there is no transgression,
one should remain

children.text: tūṣṇīṃ bhavitavyam* / tūṣṇīṃbhāvena ca vayam āyuṣmataḥ
children.translated_text: silent. By the silence of the venerable ones,
we shall

children.text: śuddhān vedayiṣyāmaḥ / yathāpi pratyekaṃ pṛṣṭasya bhikṣor vyākaraṇaṃ bhavati evam e
children.translated_text: know them to be pure. Just as there would be an answer for an individual <s>bhikṣu</s> when questioned, so
too in such
an assembly of <s>bhikṣus</s>,
when the announcement

children.text: vat trir apy anuśrāvaṇaṃ bhavati / yaḥ punar bhikṣur evaṃrūpāyāṃ bhikṣuparṣadi yāvat trir apy
children.translated_text: is made up to three times. If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, when in such an assembly of <s>bhikṣus</s>, when the announcement is made up to three times,
remembering

children.text: ran satīm āpattiṃ nāviṣkaroti saṃprajānan mṛṣāvādo 'sya bhavati / saṃprajānan mṛṣāvādaḥ khalv
children.translated_text: an existing transgression, does not disclose it, there is a deliberate falsehood on his part. A deliberate falsehood,

children.text: āyuṣmantaḥ antarāyiko dharma ukto bhagavatā / tasmāt smaratā bhikṣuṇā āpannena viśuddhāpekṣeṇa satī āpattir āviṣkartavyā / āviṣkṛtenāsya phāsu bhavati nāviṣkṛtena na bhavati /
children.translated_text: venerable ones, has been declared by the <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One) to be an obstructing quality. Therefore, a <s>bhikṣu</s> who remembers [a transgression], who has fallen [into transgression], and who seeks purification, should disclose the existing transgression. Having disclosed it, there is comfort for him; not having disclosed it, there is none.

body.translated_text: Venerable ones, we shall hold the <s>Poṣadha</s> and recite the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s>. Whoever

children.text: uddiṣṭaṃ khalu mayāyuṣmantaḥ prātimokṣasūtroddeśanidānam* / tatrāyuṣmataḥ pṛcchāmi -- kaccit sthātra pariśuddhāḥ
children.translated_text: I have recited, venerable ones, the introduction to the recitation of the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s>. Herein I ask the venerable ones: Are you pure in this matter?

children.text: dvir api trir api pṛcchāmi -- kaccit sthātra pariśuddhāḥ
children.translated_text: A second and a third time I ask: Are you pure in this matter?

children.text: atrāyuṣmanto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi /
children.translated_text: The venerable ones are pure in this matter, since they are silent — thus I hold it.
The four <s>Pārājika</s> (Defeat) rules:

children.text: ime khalu āyuṣmantaś catvāraḥ pārājikā dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśam āgacchanti /
children.translated_text: These, venerable ones, are the four <s>Pārājika</s> rules that come up for recitation of the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> every half-month.
<s>Pārājika</s> 1 [PrMoSū_Mū-Banerjee]:

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣūṇāṃ śikṣāsājīvasamāpannaḥ śikṣām apratyākhyāya śikṣādaurbalyam anāviṣkṛtyābrahmacaryaṃ maithunaṃ dharmaṃ pratisevate antatas tiryagyonigatayāpi sārdhaṃ, ayam api bhikṣuḥ pārājiko bhavaty asaṃvāsyaḥ /
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> who has undertaken the training and livelihood of <s>bhikṣus</s>, without having renounced the training and without having declared his weakness in the training, engages in the unchaste act of sexual intercourse, even with an animal — this <s>bhikṣu</s> too is <s>pārājika</s> (defeated), not in communion.
<s>Pārājika</s> 2 [PrMoSū_Mū-Banerjee]:

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur grāmagatam araṇyagataṃ vā pareṣāṃ adattaṃ steyasaṃkhyātam ādadīta yadrūpeṇādattādānena rājā vainaṃ gṛhītvā rājamātro vā hanyād vā saṃbadhnīyād vā pravāsayed vā evaṃ cainaṃ vadet* -- tvaṃ bhoḥ puruṣa cauro 'si bālo 'si steno 'sīty evaṃrūpaṃ adattaṃ bhikṣuḥ ādadita, ayam api bhikṣuḥ pārājayiko bhavaty asaṃvāsyaḥ /
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> takes what is not given — whether in a village or in the wilderness — what belongs to others with the intention of stealing, of the sort of theft for which a king or a king's minister would seize and execute, imprison, or banish him, saying: 'You, sir, are a thief, a fool, a robber!' — if a <s>bhikṣu</s> takes what is not given of this sort, this <s>bhikṣu</s> too is <s>pārājika</s> (defeated), not in communion.
<s>Pārājika</s> 3 [PrMoSū_Mū-Banerjee]:

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur manuṣyaṃ vā manuṣyavigrahaṃ vā svahastena saṃcintya jīvitād vyaparopayet* /
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> intentionally deprives a human being or one of human form of life with his own hand,

children.text: śastraṃ vainām ādhārayec chastradhārakaṃ vāsya paryeṣeta maraṇāya vainaṃ samādāpayen maraṇavarṇaṃ vāsyānusaṃvarṇayet* / evaṃ cainaṃ vadet* -- haṃbho puruṣa kiṃ tava pāpakenāśucinā durjīvitena
children.translated_text: or provides a weapon, or seeks a weapon-bearer, or encourages [someone] to die, or praises the beauty of death — and speaks thus: 'Come, good man, what use to you is this wretched, impure, miserable life?

children.text: mṛtaṃ te bho puruṣa jīvitād va
children.translated_text: Death, good man, is better

children.text: ram iti cintānumataiś cittasaṃkalpair anekaparyāyeṇa maraṇāya vainaṃ samādāpayen
children.translated_text: than life' — and with this intention, with mental resolve, in various ways encourages [someone] to die
or praises the beauty
of death
to him,

children.text: sa ca tena kālaṃ kuryād ayam api bhikṣuḥ pārājiko bhavaty asaṃvāsyaḥ /
children.translated_text: and that person dies thereby — this <s>bhikṣu</s> too is <s>pārājika</s> (defeated), not in communion.
<s>Pārājika</s> 4 [PrMoSū_Mū-Banerjee]:

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur anabhijānann aparijānann asantam asaṃvidyamānam anuttaramanuṣyadharmam ala
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, without knowing, without comprehending, claims a non-existent, non-occurring, superhuman quality —
a noble
distinction
of attainment, knowledge,

children.text: darśanaṃ sparśavihāratāṃ vā pratijānīyād idaṃ jānāmīdaṃ paśyāmīti sa pareṇa samayena samanuyujyamāno vā asamanuyujyamāno vā
children.translated_text: or vision, or attainment of [meditative] dwelling — saying 'I know this, I see this'; and at a later time, whether questioned or not questioned,
having fallen [into transgression],

children.text: viśuddhiṃ prakṣyaivaṃ vaded ajānann evāham āyu
children.translated_text: seeking purification, would speak thus: 'Not knowing, venerable ones,
I said
"I know,"
not seeing,
[I said] "I see" — [it was] an empty, hollow, false, baseless claim, except through
overestimation' —
this <s>bhikṣu</s> too
is <s>pārājika</s> (defeated), not
in communion.

body.text: uddiṣṭā mayāyuṣmantaś catvāraḥ pārājikā dharmā yeṣāṃ bhikṣur anyatamānyatamam āpattim adhyāpatya na labhate bhikṣubhiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃvāsaṃ bhogaṃ vā yathāpūrvaṃ ca tathāpaścāt pārājiko bhavaty asaṃvāsyaḥ /
body.translated_text: I have recited, venerable ones, the four <s>Pārājika</s> rules. A <s>bhikṣu</s> who has fallen into any one of these transgressions does not obtain communion or enjoyment with <s>bhikṣus</s>; as before, so afterward — he is <s>pārājika</s> (defeated), not in communion.

children.translated_text: The <s>Saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> (Requiring Formal Meeting) rules:

body.translated_text: These, venerable ones, are the thirteen <s>Saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> rules that come up for recitation of the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> every half-month.

<s>Saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> 2 [PrMoSū_Mū-Banerjee]:

children.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, with a mind overcome by lust, engages in
bodily contact

Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>,
with a mind overcome by lust, addresses a woman with coarse,
wicked, indecent speech connected with sexual intercourse,
speaking
as

to a young woman — [this is a] <s>Saṃghāvaśeṣa</s>.
<s>Saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> 4 [PrMoSū_Mū-Banerjee]:

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur avadalavipariṇatena cittena mātṛgrāmasya purastād ātmanaḥ kāyapari
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, with a mind overcome by lust, in the presence of a woman, praises the service

children.text: caryāyā saṃvarṇayed etad agraṃ mātṛsvasaḥ pari
children.translated_text: of his own body, [saying:] 'This is the highest, O sister, of

children.text: caryāṇāṃ yaduta mādṛśaṃ bhikṣuṃ śīlavantaṃ kalyāṇa
children.translated_text: services — namely, to serve a <s>bhikṣu</s> like me, who is virtuous, of good
qualities, and celibate,

children.text: m anena dharmeṇa paricared yaduta maithunopasaṃhitena saṃghāvaśeṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: with this act' — namely, one connected with sexual intercourse — [this is a] <s>Saṃghāvaśeṣa</s>.
<s>Saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> 5 [PrMoSū_Mū-Banerjee]:
Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> acts as a go-between,

children.text: ritraṃ samāpadyeta striyaṃ vā puruṣamatena puruṣaṃ vā strīmatena jāyātvena vā jā
children.translated_text: conveying a woman's [message] to a man, or a man's [message] to a woman, whether for
marriage or concubinage, even
for a momentary [union] — [this is a] <s>Saṃghāvaśeṣa</s>.
<s>Saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> 6 [PrMoSū_Mū-Banerjee]:

children.text: svayaṃ yācitā bhikṣuṇā kuṭiṃ kārayitvā asvā
children.translated_text: When a <s>bhikṣu</s> builds a hut on his own initiative, without an owner,
for his own use,

children.text: prāmāṇikā kuṭiḥ kārayitavyā / tatredaṃ kuṭyāḥ pramāṇaṃ dairghyeṇa dvādaśa vitastayaḥ
children.translated_text: the hut should be built to the proper measure. This is the measure for the hut: twelve spans (<s>vitasti</s>) in length
by the <s>Sugata</s> span, and seven

children.text: saptāntarataḥ / tena bhikṣuṇā bhikṣavo 'bhinetavyāḥ vāstudarśanāya / abhinītair bhikṣubhir vāstu draṣṭavyam anārambhaṃ saparikramam* / sārambhe ced bhikṣur vāstuny aparākrame svayaṃ yācitāṃ kuṭiṃ kārayed asvāmikām ātmoddeśakāṃ bhikṣūṃś ca
children.translated_text: in width. That <s>bhikṣu</s> should bring <s>bhikṣus</s> to inspect the site. The <s>bhikṣus</s> brought [there] should inspect the site [to ensure it is] without disturbance and with a surrounding pathway. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should build a hut on his own initiative on a site with disturbance and without a pathway, without an owner, for his own use, and should not bring <s>bhikṣus</s>

children.text: ca so 'smākaṃ caiṣaś chandaṃ ca ruciñ cādāya tu vyāharati | jānaṃś ca sa bhikṣur bhāṣate nājānan yac cāsya bhikṣoḥ rocate ca kṣamate ca asmākam api rocate ca kṣamate ca iti / te bhikṣavo bhikṣubhir evaṃ syur vacanīyā -- māyuṣmanta evaṃ vadantu na ca sa bhikṣur dharmavādī na vinayavādī adharmaṃ caiṣo 'vinayaṃ cāsmākaṃ chandaṃ ruciñ cādāya tu vyāharati nājānaṃś ca sa bhikṣur bhāṣate jānaṃś ca yac cāsya bikṣoḥ rocate ca kṣamate ca tavāyuṣmato 'pi saṃghabhedaḥ na rocate māyuṣmatām api saṃghabhedo rocate sametv āyuṣmantaḥ saṃghena samagro hi saṃgho saṃmodamāno avivadamāno ekāgradharmoddeśaḥ ekakṣīrodakībhūtaḥ śāstu darśayamānaḥ sukhaṃ sparśaṃ viharantu / tiṣṭha mā tvam āyuṣman saṃghabhedāya niḥsṛja imām evaṃrūpāṃ saṃghabhedakarāṃ kathām* / evaṃ te bhikṣavo bhikṣubhiḥ dvir api trir api samanuyoktavyāḥ samanuśāsitavyās tasya vastunaḥ pratiniḥsargāya dvir api trir api samanuyoktavyāḥ samanuśāsitavyāḥ pratiniḥsṛjeyuḥ ity evaṃ kuśalaṃ no cet pratiniḥsṛjeyuḥ saṃghāvaśeṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: and he speaks having taken up our wishes and preferences; and that <s>bhikṣu</s> speaks knowingly, not unknowingly; and what pleases and is acceptable to that <s>bhikṣu</s> pleases and is acceptable to us as well.' Those <s>bhikṣus</s> should be spoken to by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: 'Do not, Venerable Ones, speak thus. That <s>bhikṣu</s> does not speak according to the <s>Dharma</s>, nor according to the <s>Vinaya</s>; he speaks having taken up our wishes and preferences regarding what is not-<s>Dharma</s> and not-<s>Vinaya</s>; and that <s>bhikṣu</s> speaks not unknowingly but knowingly; and what pleases and is acceptable to that <s>bhikṣu</s> — may schism in the <s>Saṃgha</s> not be pleasing to you, Venerable One; may schism in the <s>Saṃgha</s> not be pleasing to the Venerable Ones either. Stand firm, Venerable One, do not (act) for the schism of the <s>Saṃgha</s>; abandon this kind of talk that causes schism in the <s>Saṃgha</s>.' children.text: saṃbahulā bhikṣavaḥ anyatamaṃ grāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upaniḥśritya vihareyus te ca syuḥ kuladūṣakāḥ pāpasamācārāḥ teṣāṃ ca kulāni duṣṭāni dṛśyeran vā śrūyeran vā prajñāyeran vā / te bhikṣavaḥ bhikṣubhir evaṃ syur vacanīyāḥ -- āyuṣmantaḥ kuladūṣakāḥ pāpasamācārāḥ yuṣmākaṃ kulāni duṣṭāni dṛśyante 'pi śrūyante 'pi prajñāyante 'pi yuṣmākaṃ ca te pāpasamācārā dṛśyante 'pi śrūyante 'pi prajñāyante 'pi prakramadhvaṃ āyuṣmantaḥ yūyaṃ asmād āvāsād alaṃ yuṣmākaṃ iha vāseneti / evaṃ cet te bhikṣavas tān bhikṣūn vadeyuḥ -- chandagāmina āyuṣmantaḥ bhikṣava dveṣagāmino mohagāmino bhayagāminaś ca evaṃrūpāyāḥ āpattyāḥ ekatya bhikṣūn pravāsayanty ekatya bhikṣūn na pravāsayantīti / tatra bhikṣavaḥ evaṃ syur vacanīyāḥ -- mā āyuṣmanta evaṃ vadata | ekatya bhikṣavaś chandagāmino dveṣagāmino mohagāmino bhayagāminaś ca evaṃrūpāyāḥ āpattyāḥ ekatya bhikṣūn pravāsayanty ekatya bhikṣūn na pravāsayantīti / tat kasmād dhetoḥ / neme bhikṣavaś chandagāmino dveṣagāmino mohagāmino bhayagāminaś ca āyuṣmanta khalu kuladūṣakāḥ pāpasamācārāḥ yuṣmākaṃ kulāni duṣṭāni dṛśyante 'pi śrūyante 'pi pāpakāś ca yuṣmākaṃ samācārā dṛśyante 'pi śrūyante 'pi prajñāyante 'pi / bhikṣava āyuṣmantaś chandagāmino dveṣagāmino mohagāmino bhayagāminaś ca -- niḥsṛjata imām evaṃrūpāṃ kathām* / te bhikṣavaḥ bhikṣubhir evaṃ bhāsitavyāḥ -- evaṃ cet pratiniḥsṛjeyuḥ ity evaṃ kuśalaṃ no cet pratiniḥsṛjeyuḥ dvir api trir api samanuyoktavyāḥ samanuśāsitavyās tasya pratiniḥsargāya dvir api trir api samanuyoktavyāḥ samanuśāsitavyāḥ pratiniḥsṛjeyuḥ ity evaṃ kuśalaṃ no cet pratiniḥsṛjeyuḥ saṃghāvaśeṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: If many <s>bhikṣus</s> dwell in dependence upon a certain village or town, and they are corrupters of families and of evil conduct, and their corrupted families are seen, heard, or known — those <s>bhikṣus</s> should be spoken to by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: 'The Venerable Ones are corrupters of families and of evil conduct; your corrupted families are seen, heard, and known; and your evil conduct is seen, heard, and known. Depart, Venerable Ones, from this dwelling; enough of your dwelling here.' If those <s>bhikṣus</s> speak thus to those <s>bhikṣus</s>: 'The Venerable <s>bhikṣus</s> act from desire, from hatred, from delusion, from fear; for an offense of this kind, they banish some <s>bhikṣus</s> and do not banish others' — then those <s>bhikṣus</s> should be spoken to thus: 'Do not, Venerable Ones, speak thus — that some <s>bhikṣus</s> act from desire, from hatred, from delusion, from fear, and for an offense of this kind, they banish some <s>bhikṣus</s> and do not banish others. For what reason? These <s>bhikṣus</s> do not act from desire, from hatred, from delusion, or from fear. The Venerable Ones are indeed corrupters of families and of evil conduct; your corrupted families are seen, heard, and known; and your evil conduct is seen, heard, and known. The <s>bhikṣus</s>, Venerable Ones, act from desire, from hatred, from delusion, and from fear — abandon this kind of talk.' Those <s>bhikṣus</s> should be spoken to by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: if they renounce, thus it is skillful; if they do not renounce, they should be admonished and instructed a second and a third time for the renunciation thereof. If they renounce, thus it is skillful; if they do not renounce, it is a <s>saṃghāvaśeṣa</s>.
SA.13

children.text: bhikṣur iha kaścid durvācyasvabhāvo bhavati uddeśyaparyāpannaiḥ śikṣāpadaiḥ sugatasūtraparyāpannaiḥ bhikṣubhiḥ sahadharmeṇa sahavinayenocyamāna ātmānam avacanīyaṃ karoti -- mā mām āyuṣmantaḥ yūyaṃ kiṃcid vadata kalyāṇam akalyāṇaṃ vā aham api āyuṣmataḥ na kiṃcid vakṣyāmi kalyāṇam akalyāṇaṃ vā viramantu āyuṣmantaḥ mama vacanād aham api viraṃsyāmi yuṣmākaṃ vacanād iti / sa bhikṣur bhikṣubhir evaṃ syād vacanīyo -- āyuṣman uddeśyaparyāpannaiḥ śikṣāpadaiḥ sugatasūtraparyāpannaiḥ bhikṣubhiḥ sahadharmeṇa sahavinayenocyamāna ātmānam tvaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoṣi āyuṣman vacanīyam eva ātmānaṃ karotu āyuṣmantam bhikṣavo sahadharmeṇa sahavinayena vadantu āyuṣmān api bhikṣūn sahadharmeṇa sahavinayena vadatu evaṃ saṃbaddhā hi tasya bhagavataḥ tathāgatasya arhato samyaksaṃbuddhasya pariṣad yad idaṃ anyonyavacanīyād anyonyāpattivyutthāpanād iti māyuṣman ātmānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karotu / sa bhikṣur bhikṣubhir evaṃ bhāsitavyaḥ -- evaṃ ced tad vastu pratiniḥsṛjed ity evaṃ kuśalaṃ no cet pratiniḥsṛjed dvir api trir api samanuyoktavyaḥ samanuśāsitavyas tasya pratiniḥsargāya dvir api trir api samanuyoktavyaḥ samanuśāsitavyaḥ pratiniḥsṛjed tad vastu ity evaṃ kuśalaṃ no cet pratiniḥsṛjet saṃghāvaśeṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: If a certain <s>bhikṣu</s> is of a nature that resists correction, and when spoken to by <s>bhikṣus</s> according to the <s>Dharma</s> and the <s>Vinaya</s> concerning training rules (<s>śikṣāpadas</s>) included in the instruction, included in the <s>Sugata</s>'s discourses, he makes himself impossible to be spoken to: 'Do not, Venerable Ones, say anything to me, whether good or bad; I too will not say anything to the Venerable Ones, whether good or bad. Let the Venerable Ones refrain from speaking to me, and I too will refrain from speaking to you.' That <s>bhikṣu</s> should be spoken to by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: 'Venerable One, when spoken to by <s>bhikṣus</s> according to the <s>Dharma</s> and the <s>Vinaya</s> concerning training rules included in the instruction, included in the <s>Sugata</s>'s discourses, you make yourself impossible to be spoken to. Venerable One, you should make yourself possible to be spoken to. Let the <s>bhikṣus</s> speak to the Venerable One according to the <s>Dharma</s> and the <s>Vinaya</s>; and let the Venerable One speak to the <s>bhikṣus</s> according to the <s>Dharma</s> and the <s>Vinaya</s>. For thus is the assembly of the Blessed One, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, made complete — namely, through being willing to speak to each other, through raising each other from offenses. Do not, Venerable One, make yourself impossible to be spoken to.' That <s>bhikṣu</s> should be spoken to by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: if he renounces that matter, thus it is skillful; if he does not renounce, he should be admonished and instructed a second and a third time for the renunciation thereof. If he renounces that matter, thus it is skillful; if he does not renounce, it is a <s>saṃghāvaśeṣa</s>.

body.text: yatrāhaṃ āyuṣmataḥ paripṛcchāmi -- kaścit sthātra pariśuddhāḥ
body.translated_text: Here I ask the Venerable Ones: Are you pure in this matter?

body.text: dvir api trir api paripṛcchāmi -- kaścit sthātra pariśuddhāḥ

body.translated_text: The Venerable Ones are pure in this matter; therefore they remain silent — thus I hold it.

body.text: III. dvāv aniyatau dharmau /
body.translated_text: III. Two <s>Aniyata</s> (Undetermined) Offenses.

body.text: imau khalu āyuṣmantau dvau aniyatau dharmau anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśam āgacchataḥ /
body.translated_text: Venerable Ones, these two <s>aniyata</s> offenses come up at the recitation of the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> every half-month.

children.translated_text: Aniy.1

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur mātṛgrāmeṇa sārdham eka ekikayā rahasi praticchanne āsane niṣadyāṃ kalpayed alaṃ kāmayitum* / sacec chrāddheyavacanopāsikā trayāṇāṃ dharmāṇām anyatamānyatamadharmeṇa vadet pārājikena vā saṃghādiśeṣeṇa vā pāyantikena vā niṣadyāṃ bhikṣuḥ prati

children.translated_text: Thirty <s>Naisargikapāyantikā</s> (Offenses Requiring Forfeiture and Expiation) Offenses.

body.text: ime khalu āyuṣmantas triṃśan naisargikāḥ pāyantikā dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśam āgacchanti /
body.translated_text: Venerable Ones, these thirty <s>naisargikapāyantikā</s> offenses come up at the recitation of the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> every half-month.

children.translated_text: NP.1

children.text: niṣṭhitacīvareṇa bhikṣuṇā uddhṛte kaṭhine daśāhaparamaṃ atirekacīvaram avikalpitaṃ dhārayitavyaṃ tataḥ uttari dhārayen naisargikā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> whose robe (<s>cīvara</s>) is complete, after the <s>kaṭhina</s> has been removed, may keep an extra robe undetermined for a maximum of ten days. If he keeps it beyond that, it is a <s>naisargikapāyantikā</s>.
NP.2

children.text: niṣṭhitacīvaro bhikṣuḥ uddhṛtakaṭhine ekarātram api cet trayāṇāṃ cīvarāṇām anyatamānyatamasya cīvarād bahiḥsīmāṃ vipravased anyatra saṃghasaṃmatyā [Hs.: saṃghasaṃvṛttyā] naisargikapāyantikā /
children.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> whose robe is complete, after the <s>kaṭhina</s> has been removed, if he should spend even one night away from any one of his three robes, beyond the boundary (<s>sīmā</s>), except with the permission of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, it is a <s>naisargikapāyantikā</s>.
NP.3

children.text: niṣṭhitacīvarasya bhikṣor uddhṛte kaṭhine utpatya akālacīvaram ākāṃkṣinā tena bhikṣuṇā tac cīvaraṃ pratigṛhītavyaṃ pratigṛhya sacet paripūryate kṣipram eva kṛtvā dhārayitavyam* / no cet paripūryate māsaparamaṃ tena bhikṣuṇā tac cīvaram upanikṣiptavyaṃ satyāṃ cīvarapratyāśāyām ūnasya vā paripūrayet tataḥ uttari upanikṣipen naisargika
children.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> whose robe is complete, after the <s>kaṭhina</s> has been removed, if an out-of-season robe should arise (for him), if he desires it, that <s>bhikṣu</s> should accept it. Having accepted it, if it completes (his set), he should quickly make it up and keep it. If it does not complete (the set), that <s>bhikṣu</s> should store that robe for a maximum of one month, provided there is an expectation of (the rest of) the robe, or to complete what is deficient. If he stores it beyond that, it is a <s>naisargika</s>-
<s>pāyantikā</s>.
NP.4

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur ajñātikayā bhikṣuṇyā purāṇacīvaraṃ dhāvayed raṃjayed ākoṭayed vā naisargikapāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should have an old robe washed, dyed, or beaten by a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> (nun) who is not a relative, it is a <s>naisargikapāyantikā</s>.
NP.5

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur ajñātikayā bhikṣuṇyā santikāc cīvaraṃ pratigṛhṇīyād anyatra parivartakān naisargikapātayantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should accept a robe from the hands of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is not a relative, except in exchange, it is a <s>naisargikapāyantikā</s>.

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur ajñātigṛhapatiṃ gṛhapatipatnīṃ vopasaṃkramya cīvaraṃ vijñāpayed anyatra samayān naisargikapāyantikā / tatrāyaṃ samaya ācchinnacīvaro bhikṣur bhavati naṣṭacīvaro dagdhacīvaro ūḍhacīvaro hṛtacīvaro 'yaṃ tatra samayaḥ /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should approach a householder or householder's wife who is not a relative and request a robe, except at the proper occasion, it is a <s>naisargikapāyantikā</s>. The proper occasion is this: a <s>bhikṣu</s> whose robe has been torn away, lost, burned, carried away, or stolen — this is the proper occasion therein.

children.translated_text: or a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, or a householder, or a townsman, or a countryman, or a wealthy person, or a guild-master, or a caravan-leader, robe-funds have been sent; may the noble one accept [them] out of compassion.' That <s>bhikṣu</s> should say this to the messenger: 'Go, venerable messenger; robe-funds are not fit to be received by <s>bhikṣu</s>s. But we accept a robe when obtained at the proper time and allowable.' If the messenger says to that <s>bhikṣu</s>: 'Is there anyone who is an attendant for the noble ones, who performs services for the noble ones?' The <s>bhikṣu</s> who needs a robe should indicate an attendant — a monastery servant or a lay devotee [saying]: 'These, messenger, are the attendants for <s>bhikṣu</s>s; these perform services for <s>bhikṣu</s>s.' Then that messenger, taking those robe-funds, proceeds to where that attendant is, approaches [him], and says to that attendant: 'Know, venerable attendant, that with these robe-funds, having chosen such and such a robe, the <s>bhikṣu</s> named so-and-so will come; you should clothe him with a robe at the proper time, with one that is allowable.' Then that messenger, having properly instructed and advised that attendant, should proceed to where that <s>bhikṣu</s> is, approach [him], and say to that <s>bhikṣu</s>: 'The attendant whom the noble one has indicated and instructed — at the proper time, approach him; he will clothe you with a robe at the proper time, with one that is allowable.' The <s>bhikṣu</s> who needs a robe should approach the attendant and remind him two or three times: 'I am in need of a robe, venerable attendant; I am in need of a robe, venerable attendant.' If, after reminding two or three times, that robe is produced — thus it is good. If it is not produced, he should stand silently in his presence four, five, or six times at most. If, after standing silently in his presence four, five, or six times at most, that robe is produced — thus it is good. If it is not produced, he should not make further effort for the production of the robe. If the robe is [then] produced — a <s>naiḥsargika pāyantikā</s> (forfeiture with confession). If it is not produced, [the monk] should himself go to the direction from which those robe-funds were brought, or send a trustworthy messenger [saying]: 'Those robe-funds that have been sent by the venerable ones designating the <s>bhikṣu</s> named so-and-so do not serve any purpose for that <s>bhikṣu</s>; may the venerable ones look after their own property, lest your property be lost.' This is the proper procedure in that case.

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ svayaṃ yācitena sūtreṇājñātinā tantuvāyena cīvaraṃ vāyeyam iti niṣpanne cīvare naisargikā pāyantikā /

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣoś cīvaraṃ datvā tataḥ paścād abhiṣiktaḥ kupitaś caṇḍībhūto nātmamanā ācchindyād ācchedayed vā evaṃ cainaṃ

'Give back,
<s>bhikṣu</s>, the robe; I shall not
again

children.translated_text: give [it] to you' — that <s>bhikṣu</s> must relinquish that robe and whatever remains; after using [the rest] — a <s>naiḥsargika pāyantikā</s> (forfeiture with confession).

children.text: daśāham āgatāyāṃ kārtikyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ bhikṣor utpadyetātyayakacīvaram ākāṃkṣatā tena bhikṣuṇā pratigṛhītavyaṃ pratigṛhya yāvac cīvaradānakālasamayād dhārayitavyaṃ tata uttaraṃ dhārayen naisargikā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: When, ten days before the full moon of <s>Kārttikī</s>, an urgent robe arises for a <s>bhikṣu</s>, the <s>bhikṣu</s> may, if he wishes, accept it; having accepted it, he should keep it until the time for the robe-giving ceremony. If he keeps it beyond that — a <s>naiḥsargika pāyantikā</s> (forfeiture with confession).
NP.27 (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> of the <s>Mūlasarvāstivādins</s>, Banerjee edition)

children.translated_text: Indeed, many <s>bhikṣu</s>s dwelling in forest lodgings are not [safe during] the rains — in those recognized as fearful,

outside the boundary, for a maximum of six

children.translated_text: nights, the forest-dwelling <s>bhikṣu</s> may remain separated from that robe outside the boundary. If he remains separated beyond that — a <s>naiḥsargika pāyantikā</s> (forfeiture with confession).
NP.28 (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> of the <s>Mūlasarvāstivādins</s>, Banerjee edition)

children.text: māsyaḥ śeṣo grīṣmāṇāṃ bhikṣuṇā varṣāśāṭīcīvaraṃ paryeṣitavyam ardhamāsāvaśiṣṭā kṛtvā dhārayitavyam* / arvāk ced bhikṣuḥ śeṣo grīṣmāṇāṃ varṣāśāṭīcīvaraṃ paryeṣeta ūrdhvam ardhamāsāvaśiṣṭā varṣāḥ kṛtvā dhārayen naisargikā pāyantikā /

body.text:
uddiṣṭā me āyuṣmantas triṃśan naisargikapāyantikā dharmāḥ / tatrāham āyuṣmantaḥ paripṛcchāmi -- kaścit sthātra pariśuddhāḥ
dvir api trir api paripṛcchāmi -- kaścit sthātra pariśuddhāḥ
pariśuddhā atrāyuṣmanto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi /
body.translated_text: I have recited for you, venerable ones, the thirty <s>naiḥsargika pāyantikā</s> (forfeiture with confession) rules. Therein I ask the venerable ones: are you pure in this matter? A second and a third time I ask: are you pure in this matter? The venerable ones are pure in this, since they remain silent — thus I understand it.

children.translated_text: The ninety <s>pāyantikā</s> (confession) rules.

children.translated_text: Pāy.1 (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> of the <s>Mūlasarvāstivādins</s>, Banerjee edition)
For deliberate lying — a <s>pāyantikā</s> (confession).
Pāy.2 (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> of the <s>Mūlasarvāstivādins</s>, Banerjee edition)
For disparaging speech — a <s>pāyantikā</s> (confession).
Pāy.3 (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> of the <s>Mūlasarvāstivādins</s>, Banerjee edition)
For slander among <s>bhikṣu</s>s — a <s>pāyantikā</s> (confession).
Pāy.4 (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> of the <s>Mūlasarvāstivādins</s>, Banerjee edition)

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan samagreṇa saṃghena yathādharmam adhikaraṇam upanikṣiptaṃ punaḥ karmaṇaḥ khoṭayet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, when a case has been properly settled by the complete <s>saṃgha</s> in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s>, should again seek to invalidate the proceeding — a <s>pāyantikā</s> (confession).
Pāy.5 (<s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> of the <s>Mūlasarvāstivādins</s>, Banerjee edition)

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur mātṛgrāmasyottari ṣaṭpaṃcikayā vācā dharmaṃ deśayed
children.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should teach the <s>Dharma</s> to a woman in more than five or six sentences —
except with a knowledgeable [person present]
anger, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s> (offense requiring expiation).
Pāy.6

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur anupasaṃpannāya pudgalāya padaśo dharmaṃ vācayet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should recite the <s>Dharma</s> word by word to a person who has not received full ordination (<s>anupasaṃpanna</s>), it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.7

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur anupasaṃpannāya pudgalāya duṣṭhulāpattim ārocayed anyatra saṃghasaṃmatyān [saṃghasaṃvṛtyā] pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should disclose a serious (<s>duṣṭhula</s>) offense to a person who has not received full ordination, except with the permission of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.8

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur anupasaṃpannāya pudgalāyottaraṃmanuṣyadharmam ārocayed bhūtāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should report a superhuman quality (<s>uttaramanuṣyadharma</s>) to a person who has not received full ordination, being true, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.9

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ pūrvaṃ samanujño bhūtvā tataḥ paścād evaṃ vaded
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having first given consent, should afterward speak thus:
'In the manner of

children.text: saṃstutikayāyuṣmantaḥ sāṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇatam ātmanaḥ paudgalikaṃ pariṇāmayantīti pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: mutual praise, Venerable Ones, they divert gains belonging to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, which have been designated (for the community), to personal use' — it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.10

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśe uddiśyamāne evaṃ vadet kiṃ punar ebhir āyuṣmantaḥ kṣudrānukṣudraiḥ śikṣāpadair anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśair uccāryamānair yāni bhikṣūṇāṃ kaukṛtyāya saṃvartante ālekhāya vilekhāya vileṭhāya vipratisārāyeti śikṣā
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, when the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> is being recited at the half-monthly recitation, should say: 'What is the use, Venerable Ones, of these minor and subsidiary training rules being recited at the half-monthly <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> recitation? They only lead the <s>bhikṣus</s> to remorse,
scratching, irritation,
and regret' — from the disparagement of the training rules, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.11
From destroying seed-life and plant-life, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.12
From evasion and prevarication, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.13
From obstructing an instruction (<s>ājñā</s>), it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.14

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sāṃghikaṃ maṃcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā vṛṣiko vā biṃbopadhānacaturaśrakaṃ vā abhyavakāśe upanikṣipyoparikṣipya vā anuddhṛtānuddhṛtya vā tato viprakrāmet santaṃ bhikṣum anavalokyānyatra tadrūpāt
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should place or leave a bed, chair, mattress, or square cushion belonging to the <s>Saṃgha</s> in the open air, or place it on top (of something), and depart without removing it, without looking for a <s>bhikṣu</s> (to entrust it to), except for a suitable
reason,
it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.15

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sāṃghike vihāre tṛṇasaṃstaraṃ vā parṇasaṃstaraṃ vā saṃstīrya vā saṃstārya vā anuddhṛtyānuddhārya vā tato viprakrāmet santaṃ bhikṣum anavalokyānyatra tadrūpāt pratyayāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should spread out or have spread out a grass-mat or leaf-mat in a dwelling belonging to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, and depart without removing it or having it removed, without looking for a <s>bhikṣu</s> (to entrust it to), except for a suitable reason, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.16

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur abhiṣaktaḥ kupitaś caṇḍībhūto 'nāttamanā sāṃghikād vihārād bhikṣuṃ niṣkarṣen niṣkārṣāpayed vā anyatra tadrūpāt pratyayāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, being hostile, angry, wrathful, and displeased, should evict or cause to be evicted a <s>bhikṣu</s> from a dwelling belonging to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, except for a suitable reason, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.17

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan sāṃghike vihāre pūrvopagatānāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ tataḥ paścād āgatyānupraskandyāsane niṣadyāṃ śayyāṃ vā kalpayed yasya saṃbādho bhaviṣyati sa viprakramiṣyatīti ity eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, in a dwelling belonging to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, having come after <s>bhikṣus</s> who arrived earlier, should encroach and arrange a seat or bed (thinking), 'Whoever is cramped will leave' — making this his reason, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.18

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan sāṃghike vihāre uparivihāyasikṛtāyāṃ kuṭikāyām āhāryapādake maṃce vā pīṭhe vā sahasā balenābhipaded vābhinipadyeta vā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, in a dwelling belonging to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, in an upper-story cell with a raised floor, should sit down forcefully or lie down forcefully on a bed or chair with detachable legs, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.19

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan saprāṇakenodakena tṛṇaṃ vā gomayaṃ vā mṛttikāṃ vā siñcet siñcayed vā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should sprinkle or cause to be sprinkled grass, cow-dung, or earth with water containing living beings, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.20

children.text: mahāntaṃ bhikṣuṇā vihāraṃ kārayitvā yāvad dvārakośārgalasthānād ālokasaṃjñinā bhūmiparikarmopādāya dvau vā trayo vā chedanaparyāyāḥ saharitāḥ adhiṣṭhātavyāḥ tata uttari adhitiṣṭhet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: When a <s>bhikṣu</s> has had a large dwelling (<s>vihāra</s>) built, from the preparation of the ground up to the door-frame, bolt-holder, and window-openings, he should oversee two or three layers of roofing; if he oversees beyond that, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.21

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur asaṃmataḥ saṃghena bhikṣuṇīr avavadet tadrūpadharmasamanvāgamāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, not appointed by the <s>Saṃgha</s>, should instruct <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> (nuns) — by being endowed with the requisite <s>Dharma</s> qualities — it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.22

children.text: saṃmataś cāpi bhikṣur saṃghena yāvat sūryāstagamanakālasamayāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: Even a <s>bhikṣu</s> appointed by the <s>Saṃgha</s> (should not instruct nuns) beyond the time of sunset, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.23

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣum evaṃ vaded āmiṣakiṃcithetor bhikṣavo bhikṣuṇīr avadantīti pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should say to a <s>bhikṣu</s>: 'The <s>bhikṣus</s> instruct <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for the sake of material gain,' it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.24

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur ajñātikāyai bhikṣuṇyai cīvaraṃ dadyād anyatra parivartakāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should give a robe to a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is not a relative, except in exchange, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.25

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur ajñātikāyā bhikṣuṇyāś cīvaraṃ kuryāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should make a robe for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is not a relative, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.26

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣuṇīsārtheṇa sārdham adhvānamārgaṃ pratipadyeta ato grāmāntaram api pāyantikā / tatrāyaṃ samayaḥ sārthagamanīyo mārgo bhavati sāśaṅkasaṃmataḥ sabhayasaṃmataḥ sapratibhayabhairavasaṃmato 'yaṃ tatra samayaḥ /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should travel on the road with a group of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, even from one village to the next, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>. The proper occasion is this: the road to be traveled in a caravan is one agreed upon as dangerous, fearful, and terrifyingly perilous — this is the proper occasion therein.
Pāy.27

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣuṇīsārtheṇa sārdhaṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvam abhirohed ūrdhvagāminīṃ vā adhogāminīṃ vānyatra tīryakpārasantaraṇāt pātayantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having made an arrangement with a group of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, should board the same boat, whether going upstream or downstream, except for a straight crossing to the other bank, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.28

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur mātṛgrāmena sārdham eka ekayā rahasi praticchanne āsane niṣadyāṃ kalpayet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should sit down alone with a woman, one to one, in a secluded, concealed seat, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.29

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣuṇyā sārdham eka ekikayā rahasi praticchanne tiṣṭhet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should stand alone with a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, one to one, in a secluded, concealed (place), it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.30

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan bhikṣuṇīparipācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuṃjītānyatra pūrvaṃ gṛhisamāraṃbhāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should consume alms-food that has been prepared by a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, except when it was originally a householder's undertaking, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.31

children.text: paraṃparabhojanād anyatra samayāt pāyantikā / tatrāyaṃ samayo glānasamayaḥ karmasamayaḥ
children.translated_text: From accepting successive meals (at the same house), except at the proper occasion, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>. The proper occasion is this: when one is ill, when there is communal work,
when traveling on
the road, and when it is the time for giving robes.
Pāy.32

children.text: ekāvasathoṣitena bhikṣuṇā aglānenaikapiṇḍapātaḥ paribhoktavyas tataḥ uttari paribhuṃjīta pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> who has stayed one night (in a dwelling), if not ill, should consume only one meal of alms-food. If he consumes beyond that, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.33
If many <s>bhikṣus</s>
visit families

children.text: saṃkrāmeyus tāṃś cec chrāddhā brāhmaṇagṛhapatayas tv arthaṃ pravārayeyur maṇḍaiś cāpūpaiś cākāṃkṣibhis tair bhikṣubhir dvau trayo vā pātrapūrāḥ pratigrahītavyāḥ tata uttari
children.translated_text: and devout <s>brāhmaṇa</s> householders should invite them with cakes and sweets, those <s>bhikṣus</s>, if they desire, should accept two or three bowlfuls. If beyond that
they should

children.text: gṛhṇīyuḥ pāyantikā / dvau trīn vā pātrapūrān pratigṛhya tair bhikṣubhir bahirārāmaṃ gatvā santo bhikṣavaḥ saṃvibhaktavyā ātmanā ca paribhoktavyam ayaṃ tatra samayaḥ /
children.translated_text: accept, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>. Having accepted two or three bowlfuls, those <s>bhikṣus</s> should go outside the monastery and distribute (the food) among <s>bhikṣus</s> who are present, and consume it themselves — this is the rule therein.
Pāy.34

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhuktavān pravāritaḥ akṛtātiriktaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ khāded bhuñjīta vā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has eaten and been satisfied should eat or consume hard or soft food that has not been declared as surplus (<s>atiriktam</s>), it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.35

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan bhikṣuṃ bhuktavantaṃ akṛtātirikte khā
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should invite a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has eaten, with hard
or soft

children.text: bhojanīyenetyarthaṃ pravārayed idam āyuṣman khāda idaṃ bhuṃkṣva ity āsvādanaprekṣī kaścid eṣa bhikṣur āsvādito bhaviṣyati ity etad eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: food that has not been declared as surplus, (saying) 'Venerable One, eat this, consume this,' with the intention of testing — 'Let this <s>bhikṣu</s> be tested' — making this his reason, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.36
From eating in a
group

children.text: d anyatra samayāt pāyantikā / tatrāyaṃ samayaḥ glānasamayaḥ karmasamayo
children.translated_text: except at the proper occasion, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>. The proper occasion is this: when ill, when there is communal work,
when traveling on

children.text: samayo nāvādhirohaṇaṃ mahāsamājaḥ śramaṇabhaktasamayo 'yaṃ tatra samayaḥ /
children.translated_text: the road, when embarking on a boat, at a great assembly, and at a meal for ascetics (<s>śramaṇas</s>) — this is the proper occasion therein.
Pāy.37
If
a <s>bhikṣu</s>

children.translated_text: should eat or consume hard or soft food at the wrong time, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.38

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ saṃnihitaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ khāded bhuñjīta vā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should eat or consume hard or soft food that has been stored up, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.39
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should take what has not been given
through the door of the mouth
(i.e., consume), except water and tooth-cleaning sticks, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.40

children.text: yāni tāni bhagavatā bhikṣūṇāṃ praṇītabhojanāny akhyātāni tadyathā kṣīraṃ dadhi navanītaṃ matsyo māṃsaṃ vallūrī yaḥ puna
children.translated_text: Whatever choice foods have been declared by the Blessed One for <s>bhikṣus</s>, namely: milk, curd, butter, fish, meat, and dried meat — if a <s>bhikṣu</s>,

children.text: evaṃrūpāṇi praṇītabhojanāni ātmārtham aglānaḥ parakulebhyo vijñāpya khāded bhuñjītā vā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: not being ill, should request such choice foods from other families for himself and eat or consume them, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.41

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan saprāṇakam udakaṃ paribhuñjīta pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should consume water containing living beings, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.42

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan sabhojane kule anupraskandyāsane niṣadyāṃ kalpayet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should sit down at a seat in a family where a meal is being served, intruding, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.43

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan sabhojane kule praticchanne tiṣṭhet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should stand concealed in a family where a meal is being served, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.44

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur acelakāya vā acelikā
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should give hard or soft food with his own hand to a naked ascetic (<s>acelaka</s>), or a female naked ascetic
(<s>acelikā</s>),

children.text: parivrājakāya vā svahastaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ dadyāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: or a wandering ascetic (<s>parivrājaka</s>), it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.45

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur udyuktāṃ senāṃ darśanāyopasaṃkrāmet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should approach a deployed army to see it, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.46
If there is a suitable

children.translated_text: reason for the <s>bhikṣu</s> to approach a deployed army to see it, that <s>bhikṣu</s> may stay with that army for a maximum of two nights. If he stays
beyond that, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.47
Even if a <s>bhikṣu</s> stays for a maximum of two nights

children.text: m api ced bhikṣus tasyāṃ senāyāṃ vipravasāṃ udyūṣikāṃ vā gacched dhvajāgraṃ vā balāgraṃ vā senāvyūham anīkadarśanaṃ vā pratyanubhavet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: with that army, if he should go to a battlefield, or to the front of the banner, or to the front of the troops, or should witness an army formation or a review of forces, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.48
If a <s>bhikṣu</s>,

children.text: kupitaś caṇḍībhūto 'nāttamanā bhikṣoḥ prahāraṃ dadyāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: being angry, wrathful, and displeased, should strike a <s>bhikṣu</s>, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.49

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur abhiṣaktaḥ kupitaś caṇḍībhūto 'nāttamanā bhikṣoḥ prahāram upa
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, being hostile, angry, wrathful, and displeased, should raise
a hand against a <s>bhikṣu</s> in a threatening gesture, even so much as a slap
of the palm, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.50

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan bhikṣoḥ duṣṭhulām āpattiṃ praticchādayet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should conceal a serious (<s>duṣṭhula</s>) offense of a <s>bhikṣu</s>, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.51

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣum evaṃ vaded ehy āyuṣman kulāny upasaṃkramāvas tatra te dāpayiṣyāmi
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should say to a <s>bhikṣu</s>: 'Come, Venerable One, let us visit families together; there I will give you
hard and soft

children.text: nīyaṃ yāvadāptaṃ / sa tasya dāpayitvā praṇītaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ yāvadāptaṃ tataḥ paścād evaṃ vaded gaccha tvam āyuṣman na mama tvayā sārdhaṃ sparśo 'pi tu ekākina eva me sparśo bhavati kathāyāṃ vā niṣadyāyāṃ vā ity udyojanaprekṣī kaścid eṣa bhikṣur udyojito bhaviṣyatīty etad eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: food to your fill.' And having given him choice hard and soft food to his fill, should afterward say: 'Go, Venerable One; for me there is no comfort in your company. Rather, for me alone there is comfort, whether in conversation or in sitting' — with the intention of getting rid of him — 'Let this <s>bhikṣu</s> be gotten rid of' — making this his reason, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.52
If a <s>bhikṣu</s>,

children.text: r bhikṣur ātmārtham aglāno vitapanaprekṣī jyotiḥ samavadhavyāt samavadhāpayed vā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: not being ill, for his own benefit, with the intention of warming himself, should kindle a fire or cause one to be kindled, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.53

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur dhārmikasaṃghakaraṇīye bhikṣoś chandaṃ datvā paścād abhiṣaktaḥ
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having given his consent for a lawful communal proceeding of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, should afterward, being hostile,
angry, wrathful, and displeased,

children.text: kṣepadharmam āpadyeta / āhara bhikṣoś chandaṃ na te dadāmīti pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: resort to the act of rejection — 'Take back the <s>bhikṣu</s>'s consent; I do not give it (anymore)' — it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.54

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur anupasaṃpannena pudgalena sārdhaṃ dvirātrād ūrdhvaṃ sahāgāra
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should share a room for sleeping for more than two nights with a person who has not received full ordination (<s>anupasaṃpanna</s>),
it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.55

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur evaṃ vadet tathāhaṃ bhagavato dharmaṃ deśitam ājānāmi yathā ye antarāyikā dharmā uktā bhagavatā te pratisevyamānā nālam antarāyāyeti /
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should say: 'I understand the <s>Dharma</s> taught by the Blessed One in such a way that those things called obstructive (<s>antarāyika</s>) by the Blessed One, when practiced, are not sufficient to cause obstruction,'

children.translated_text: thus: 'Do not, Venerable One, speak thus: "I understand the <s>Dharma</s> taught by the Blessed One in such a way that those things called obstructive by the Blessed One, when practiced,
are not sufficient to cause obstruction."

nouncing, thus it is skillful;

If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should (associate with) a person who holds such views,

children.text: no cet pratiniḥsṛjed dvir api trir api samanuyoktavyaḥ samanuśāsitavyas tasya vastunaḥ pratiniḥsargāya dvir api trir api samanuyujyamānaḥ samanuśiṣyamānas tad vastu pratiniḥsṛjed ity evaṃ kuśalaṃ no cet pratiniḥsṛjet sa
children.translated_text: If he does not relinquish it, he should be questioned and instructed a second and third time for the abandonment of that matter. If, being questioned and instructed a second and third time, he relinquishes that matter, that would be good. If he does not relinquish it, that

children.text: śramaṇoddeśo bhikṣubhir idaṃ syād vacanīyo 'dyāgreṇāyuṣman śramaṇoddeśa nāsau bhagavāṃs tathāgataḥ
children.translated_text: <s>śramaṇoddeśa</s> should be addressed by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: 'From this day forward, Venerable <s>śramaṇoddeśa</s>, that <s>Bhagavat</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>,

children.text: arhan samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ śāstā / evaṃrūpasyānyatamānyatmasya brahmacāriṇaḥ pṛṣṭataḥ mā samanubadhāna
children.translated_text: the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Enlightened One, is not your teacher. And do not follow after any other celibate of such a kind.
Furthermore, whereas other <s>śramaṇoddeśas</s>

children.text: labhante bhikṣubhiḥ sārdhaṃ dvirātraparamaṃ sahāgāraśayyāṃ sāpi te adyāgreṇa nāsti cara careṇa mohapuruṣa naśyati / yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan tathānāśitaṃ śramaṇoddeśam upasthāpayed vā upalālayed vā tena vā sārdhaṃ sahāgāraśayyāṃ kalpayet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: are allowed to share sleeping quarters with <s>bhikṣus</s> for a maximum of two nights, that too is no longer permitted to you from this day forward. Go away, deluded man, be gone!' If any <s>bhikṣu</s> knowingly should attend upon, nurture, or share sleeping quarters with a <s>śramaṇoddeśa</s> who has been so expelled, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.58

children.text: navaṃ khalu bhikṣuṇā cīvaraṃ pratilabhya trayāṇāṃ durvarṇīkaraṇānām anyatamānyatamaḥ nīlo vā lohito vā pīto vā durvarṇīkaraṇāya ādātavyo 'nādāya ced bhikṣus trayāṇāṃ durvarṇīkaraṇānām anyatamānyatamaṃ durvaṇīkaraṇaṃ nīlaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā pītaṃ vā navaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuṃjīta pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: Indeed, when a <s>bhikṣu</s> obtains a new robe (<s>cīvara</s>), one of the three discoloring agents — blue, red, or yellow — should be applied for discoloring. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, without applying one of the three discoloring agents — blue, red, or yellow — should use a new robe, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.59

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣu ratnaṃ vā ratnasaṃmataṃ vā svahastena udgṛhṇīyād udgrāhayed vānyatrādhyārāmagatād vādhyāvāsagatād vā pāyantikā / bhikṣuṇādhyārāmagataṃ vādhyāvāsagataṃ vā ratnaṃ ratnasaṃmataṃ vā udgrahītavyaṃ yasyedaṃ bhaviṣyati so hariṣyati ity evaṃ manasikṛtvā / ayaṃ tatra samayaḥ /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should pick up or cause to be picked up a precious thing or something considered precious with his own hands, except when found in a monastery or dwelling place, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>. A <s>bhikṣu</s> should pick up a precious thing or something considered precious found in a monastery or dwelling place, thinking 'Whoever this belongs to will take it.' This is the rule therein.
Pāy.60

children.text: bhagavatā deśitam anvardhamāsaṃ snāyād anyatra samayāt tadatikramāt pāyantikā / ayaṃ tatra samayaḥ -- adhyardho māsaḥ śeṣo grīṣmāṇāṃ pūrvo māso varṣāṇāṃ ity ete ardhatṛtīyamāsā uṣṇasamayo 'vaśiṣṭaṃ glānasamayaḥ karmasamayo vṛṣṭisamayo vātavṛṣṭisamayo 'yaṃ tatra samayaḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhagavat</s> has taught that one should bathe every half-month; transgressing that, except at the proper occasion, is a <s>pāyantikā</s>. The proper occasion therein is: the last half-month of summer and the first month of the rains — these two and a half months are the hot season; the remainder is: the time of illness, the time of work, the time of rain, the time of wind and rain. This is the rule therein.
Pāy.61

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ saṃcintya tīryagyonigataṃ prāṇinaṃ jīvitād vyaparopayet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should intentionally deprive an animal of life, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.62

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ saṃcintya kaccid asya bhikṣor muhūrtam api tāvad aphāṣaṃ sparśaṃ bhaved etad eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā bhikṣoḥ kaukṛtyam upasaṃharet pātayantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should intentionally cause remorse to another <s>bhikṣu</s>, thinking 'Perhaps this <s>bhikṣu</s> will have an unpleasant feeling even for a moment,' doing so for that very purpose, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.63
For tickling with the fingers, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.64
For sporting in water, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.65

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur mātṛgrāmeṇa sārdhaṃ sahāgāraśayyāṃ kalpayet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should share sleeping quarters with a woman, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.66

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣuṃ bhīṣayed bhīṣāpayed vāntato hāsyaprekṣyam api pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should frighten or cause to frighten another <s>bhikṣu</s>, even in jest, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.67

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣor vā bhikṣuṇyā vā śikṣamāṇāyā vā śrāmaṇerasya vā śrāmaṇerikāyā vā pātraṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā upānahaṃ vā sūcīgharaṃ vā kāyabandhanaṃ vānyatamānyatamaṃ vā jīvitapariṣkāram upanidadhyād upanidhāpayet tadrūpapratyayād anyatra pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should hide or cause to be hidden a bowl, robe, sandal, needle-case, belt, or any other requisite of a <s>bhikṣu</s>, <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, <s>śikṣamāṇā</s> (female probationer), <s>śrāmaṇera</s> (male novice), or <s>śrāmaṇerikā</s> (female novice), except for a corresponding reason, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.68

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣoś cīvaram vikalya tataḥ paścād apratyuddhārya paribhuṃjīta pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, having agreed to share a robe with another <s>bhikṣu</s>, should afterwards use it without returning it, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.69

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ kupito 'nāttamanā pariśuddhaṃ anāpattikaṃ bhikṣuṃ amūlakena saṃghāvaśeṣeṇa dharmeṇānudhvaṃsayet pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, being angry and displeased, should charge a pure, innocent <s>bhikṣu</s> with a groundless <s>saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> (communal) offense, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.70

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur apuruṣayā striyā sārdhaṃ saṃvidhāyādhvamārgaṃ pratipadyetāntato grāmāntaram api pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should arrange to travel on the road together with a woman without a male companion, even for the distance of one village, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.71

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ steyasārthena sārdhaṃ saṃvidhāyādhvamārgaṃ pratipadyetāntato grāmāntaram api pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should arrange to travel on the road together with a caravan of thieves, even for the distance of one village, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.72

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur ūnaviṃśavarṣaṃ pudgalaṃ bhikṣubhāvāyopasaṃpādayeta pāyantikā / sa ca pudgalo 'nupasaṃpannas te ca bhikṣavo garhyā ayaṃ tatra samayaḥ /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should ordain a person under twenty years of age for the state of a <s>bhikṣu</s>, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>. And that person is not ordained, and those <s>bhikṣus</s> are blameworthy. This is the rule therein.
Pāy.73

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ svahastena pṛthivīṃ khanyāt khānayed vā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should dig the earth with his own hands or cause it to be dug, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.74

children.text: cāturmāsikapravāraṇā bhikṣuṇā svīkartavyā tatottaraṃ pāyantikā / pratyekapravāraṇāyā punaḥ punaḥ pravāraṇāyāḥ kālikapravāraṇāyā nityapravāraṇāyā anyatra ayaṃ tatra samayaḥ /
children.translated_text: A four-month invitation (<s>pravāraṇā</s>) should be accepted by a <s>bhikṣu</s>; beyond that it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>. Except for a separate invitation, a repeated invitation, a periodic invitation, or a standing invitation — this is the rule therein.
Pāy.75

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣubhir āyuṣmatā tvayā śikṣāyāṃ śikṣitavyam iti ucyamāna evaṃ vaden nāhaṃ tava bālasya mūḍhasya duṣprajñasya vacanāni śikṣiṣyāmi yāvan nāhaṃ bhikṣūn prakṣyāmi sūtradharān vinayadharān mātṛkadharān iti pāyantikā / sarvajñatākāmena bhikṣuṇā śikṣāyāṃ śikṣitavyaṃ bhikṣavaḥ praṣṭavyāḥ sūtradharā vinayadharā mātṛkadharā ayaṃ tatra samayaḥ /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, when told by <s>bhikṣus</s>, 'Venerable one, you should train yourself in the training,' should speak thus: 'I will not train according to the words of you — a fool, an ignorant one, one of poor wisdom — until I have asked <s>bhikṣus</s> who are bearers of the <s>Sūtra</s>, bearers of the <s>Vinaya</s>, bearers of the <s>Mātṛkā</s>,' it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>. A <s>bhikṣu</s> desiring omniscience should train in the training and should ask <s>bhikṣus</s> who are bearers of the <s>Sūtra</s>, bearers of the <s>Vinaya</s>, bearers of the <s>Mātṛkā</s>. This is the rule therein.
Pāy.76

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣūṇāṃ kalahajātānāṃ bhaṇḍanajātānāṃ bhedagṛhītānāṃ vivādam āpannānāṃ tūṣṇīm upaśrutikas tiṣṭhed yad ete bhikṣavo vakṣyanti tad ahaṃ dhārayiṣyāmīty etad eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should stand silently eavesdropping on <s>bhikṣus</s> who have fallen into quarrel, dispute, taken sides, and entered into controversy, thinking 'What those <s>bhikṣus</s> will say, that I shall remember,' doing so for that very purpose, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.77

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ saṃghe dharmikāyāṃ viniścayakathāyāṃ vartamānāyāṃ āsanāt tūṣṇīm utthāya prakrāmet santaṃ bhikṣum anavapṛcchyānyatra tadrūpapratyayāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, while a lawful deliberation is taking place in the <s>Saṃgha</s>, should silently rise from his seat and depart without taking leave of a fellow <s>bhikṣu</s>, except for a corresponding reason, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.78
For disrespectful conduct, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.79
For drinking <s>surā</s> (fermented liquor), <s>maireya</s> (distilled liquor), or intoxicants, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.80

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur akāle grāmaṃ praviśet santaṃ bhikṣum anavapṛcchya anyatra tadrūpāt pratyayāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should enter a village at an improper time without taking leave of a fellow <s>bhikṣu</s>, except for a corresponding reason, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.81

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sabhaktaḥ kule nimantritaḥ pūrvabhaktaṃ paścādbhaktaṃ kuleṣu cāritram āpadyeta santaṃ kulaṃ apratisaṃvedito 'nyatra tadrūpāt pratyayāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, having been invited for a meal at a family, should visit families before or after the meal without informing the host family, except for a corresponding reason, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.82

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur anirgatāyāṃ rajanyām anudgate 'ruṇe anirhṛteṣu ratneṣu ratnasaṃmateṣu vā rājñaḥ kṣatriyasya mūrdhābhiṣiktasya indrakīlaṃ vā indrakīlasāmantakaṃ vā samatikraned anyatra tadrūpāt pratyayāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, while the night has not ended and dawn has not arisen, and the precious things or things considered precious of a consecrated <s>kṣatriya</s> king have not been removed, should cross the threshold or the vicinity of the threshold, except for a corresponding reason, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.83

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtre uddiśyamāne evaṃ vaded idānīm ahaṃ jānāmi āyuṣmanto 'yam api kila dharmaḥ sūtragataḥ sūtraparyāyāpannoddeśyam āgacchatīti tatrāyuṣmantaṃ ced bhikṣavo jānīyuḥ niṣaṇṇapūrvaṃ āyuṣmatā dvitrikṛtvaṃ poṣadhe kaḥ punar vādo bhūya iti āyuṣmato ajñānataḥ na muktiḥ yata āpattim āpannaḥ tato yathādharmaṃ kārayitavya uttaraṃ ca kaukṛtyam āropayitavyaṃ -- āyuṣman te alābho 'labdhaḥ durlabdho na sulabdho yat tvaṃ anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddiśyamāne na satkṛtya śṛṇoṣi na gurukaroṣi nārthikaroṣi na manasikaroṣi ekāgracittenāvahitaśrotreṇa na śṛṇoṣi sarvacittasaṃkalpair api na śṛṇoṣi / āyuṣman tatra kaukṛtyāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s>, when the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> is being recited every half-month, should say thus: 'Only now do I know, Venerable Ones, that this rule too, included in the <s>Sūtra</s>, belonging to the <s>Sūtra</s> collection, comes up for recitation' — if the Venerable Ones should know that <s>bhikṣu</s> has previously sat through two or three <s>poṣadha</s> (observance) ceremonies, how much more often — that Venerable One is not freed on account of his ignorance. Whatever offense he has committed, he should be dealt with according to the <s>Dharma</s>, and further, remorse should be imposed upon him: 'It is your loss, Venerable One, it is ill-gotten, not well-gotten, that when the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> is being recited every half-month, you do not listen with respect, with reverence, with attention, with mindfulness, with a concentrated mind and attentive ear, nor do you listen with all your mental resolve.' Venerable one, for that remorse, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.84

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur asthimayaṃ vā viṣāṇamayaṃ vā sūcigharaṃ kārayet tad bhedanāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should have a needle-case made of bone or horn, it must be broken; it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.85

children.text: bhikṣuṇā saṃghasya pīṭhaṃ vā mañcaṃ kārayatā sugatāṣṭāṅgulipramāṇāḥ pādāḥ kārayitavyā anyatra adhastāt* aṭanyās tata uttaraṃ kārayec chedanāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a stool or bench made for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the legs should be made to the measure of eight <s>Sugata</s> finger-breadths, excluding the frame below. If he has it made exceeding that, it must be cut down; it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.86

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣus tūlasaṃstṛtaṃ pīṭhaṃ vā mañcaṃ avanahed avanāhayed vā uddalanāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should stuff or cause to be stuffed a stool or bench with cotton, it must be torn off; it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.87

children.text: niṣīdanaṃ bhikṣuṇā kārayatā prāmāṇikaṃ kārayitavyaṃ tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ -- dīrghato vitastrī dve sugatavitastyās tīryak sārdhavitastir daśānāñ ca vitastis tata uttaraṃ kārayed bhedanāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a sitting cloth (<s>niṣīdana</s>) made, it should be made to the proper measure. The measure therein is: two <s>Sugata</s> hand-spans in length, one and a half in width, and a border of one hand-span of ten finger-breadths. If he has it made exceeding that, it must be cut; it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.88

children.text: kaṇḍupraticchādanaṃ bhikṣuṇā kārayatā prāmāṇikaṃ kārayitavyaṃ tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ -- dīrghataś catasro vitastayaḥ sugatavitastyas tiryag dve tata uttaraṃ kārayec chedanāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having an itch-covering cloth (<s>kaṇḍupraticchādana</s>) made, it should be made to the proper measure. The measure therein is: four <s>Sugata</s> hand-spans in length, two in width. If he has it made exceeding that, it must be cut; it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.89

children.text: varṣāśāṭīcīvaraṃ bhikṣuṇā kārayatā prāmāṇikaṃ kārayitavyaṃ tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ -- dīrghataḥ ṣaṭ vitastayaḥ sugatavitastyas tiryak sārdhe dve tata uttaraṃ kārayec chedanāt pāyantikā /
children.translated_text: When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a rain-bathing cloth (<s>varṣāśāṭī</s>) made, it should be made to the proper measure. The measure therein is: six <s>Sugata</s> hand-spans in length, two and a half in width. If he has it made exceeding that, it must be cut; it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>.
Pāy.90

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sugatacīvarapramāṇaṃ cīvaraṃ kārayed uttaraṃ vā sugatacīvarāt pāyantikā / tatredaṃ sugatacīvarapramāṇaṃ dīrghato nava vitastayaḥ tiryak ṣaḍ vitastayaḥ idaṃ sugatacīvarapramāṇam* /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should have a robe made to the <s>Sugata</s> robe-measure, or exceeding the <s>Sugata</s> robe-measure, it is a <s>pāyantikā</s>. The <s>Sugata</s> robe-measure therein is: nine hand-spans in length, six hand-spans in width — this is the <s>Sugata</s> robe-measure.
Conclusion of the <s>Pāyantikā</s> section.

children.text: uddiṣṭā mayāyuṣmanto navatiḥ pāyantikā dharmāḥ / tatrāham āyuṣmantaḥ pṛcchāmi -- kaccit sthātra pariśuddhāḥ
children.translated_text: Venerable Ones, I have recited the ninety <s>pāyantikā</s> offenses. Here I ask the Venerable Ones: Are you pure in this matter?

children.text: pariśuddhā atrāyuṣmanto yasmāt tuṣṇīm evāhaṃ dhārayāmi /
children.translated_text: The Venerable Ones are pure in this matter; therefore they remain silent — thus I hold it.
IV. Four <s>Pratideśanīya</s> (Offenses Requiring Confession) Offenses.

children.text: ime khalv āyuṣmantaś catvāraḥ pratideśanīyā dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśam āgacchanti /
children.translated_text: Venerable Ones, these four <s>pratideśanīya</s> offenses come up at the recitation of the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> every half-month.
Pratid.1

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur antagṛhaṃ piṇḍāya carantyā ajñātyā bhikṣuṇyāḥ santikāt sahastaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ pratigṛhya khāded vā bhuñjīta vā tena bhikṣuṇā bahirārāmaṃ gatvā bhikṣor antike pratideśayitavyam garhyam asmy āyuṣmantaḥ sthānam āpanno 'sātmyaṃ pratideśanīyaṃ taṃ dharmaṃ pratideśayāmīti ayam api dharmaḥ pratideśanīyaḥ /
children.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣu</s> should accept with his own hand and eat or consume solid or soft food from the hands of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is not a relative and who is going for alms into a household, that <s>bhikṣu</s>, having gone outside the monastery, should confess before another <s>bhikṣu</s>: 'Venerable One, I have committed a blameworthy act, an unsuitable <s>pratideśanīya</s> offense; I confess that offense.' saṃmukhavinayārhāya saṃmukhavinayaṃ dāsyāmaḥ / smṛtivinayārhāya smṛtivinayaṃ dāsyāmaḥ / amūḍhavinayārhāya amūḍhavinayaṃ dāsyāmaḥ / yadbhūyeṣiyārhāya yadbhūyeṣiyaṃ dāsyāmaḥ / tatsvabhāveṣiyārhāya tatsvabhāveṣiyaṃ dāsyāmaḥ / tṛṇaprastārakārhāya tṛṇaprastārakaṃ dāsyāmaḥ / pratijñākārakārhāya pratijñāṃ dāsyāmaḥ /
utpannotpannāny adhikaraṇāny ebhiḥ saptabhir adhikaraṇaśamathair dharmair dāpayiṣyāmaḥ śamayiṣyāmo vyupaśamayiṣyāmo dharmavinaye śāstuḥ śāsane /
body.translated_text: To one deserving settlement by presence (<s>saṃmukhavinaya</s>), we shall give settlement by presence. To one deserving settlement by recollection (<s>smṛtivinaya</s>), we shall give settlement by recollection. To one deserving settlement by past insanity (<s>amūḍhavinaya</s>), we shall give settlement by past insanity. To one deserving settlement by majority (<s>yadbhūyeṣiya</s>), we shall give settlement by majority. To one deserving settlement by the nature of the case (<s>tatsvabhāveṣiya</s>), we shall give settlement by the nature of the case. To one deserving the spreading of grass (<s>tṛṇaprastāraka</s>), we shall give the spreading of grass. To one deserving settlement by confession (<s>pratijñākāraka</s>), we shall give confession. Whatever disputes arise, we shall, by these seven methods for settling disputes, settle them, pacify them, and completely pacify them in the <s>Dharma</s>-<s>Vinaya</s>, in the Teacher's dispensation.
